svg.title: The complete process of meiosis
svg.desc: Before S: 2n,2C. After S:2n,4C. Homologues pair and exchange DNA, align and separate. After meiosis I: two n,2C cells. Chromosomes align singly and sisters separate. After meiosis II: four n,1C products. Anaphase counts refer to each undivided cell, with per-pole states separately labelled.

g.text: Two homologous pairs · one possible orientation and crossover
Counts are PER CELL unless marked per pole. No replication between the divisions.
